name: Calligrapher MAMI
introduction: Creating a new genre “Calligraf2ity”—this combines the hip hop culture of graffiti with another form of linguistic art: Japanese calligraphy. Calligraphy + Graffiti = Calligraf2ity What does this mean? “2" representing the sound “fu” goes back to the traditional Japanese counting system: Hi fu mi yo… (for 1, 2, 3, 4…). Merging Japanese calligraphy with graffiti, these “two” seemingly disparate cultures make up the fu(2)ture culture of Calligraf2ity.
